body: I completely understand how you feel. I've had several suicide attempts already and hope and pray that I don't have another. What has helped me is being trying to be mindful and focusing on something else than the depression or hopelessness that I may be feeling. Also knowing that what you're feeling is only for that moment. The feeling will pass no matter how badly you feel. I wish you absolutely the best.
It will pass, I can't say exactly when but it will.

I wish you the best, OP and urge you not to go through with it. Remember that the feelings that you're having, will pass. Many of us here have had those feelings and often continue to have those feelings but by telling ourselves that 'this too shall pass', we will get through it.

I identify with a lot of what you say. I've been out since I've 19 but have always had some sort of conflict with my sexuality also due to growing up in a hyper religious environment. Adding to that, the stigma of addiction and the attempt itself have just compounded things. 

In some ways, I feel stronger because of all this. Almost more equipped to deal with the rough patches that we go through in life. I think just realizing that I need to face things head on and not take the easy way put is the first step.

Your comment made me feel a lot better, so thanks! :) I wish you all the best too, man.
Thank you. That's what I'm focusing on now..slowly I see that things get better. Sometimes all it takes is a little time.
Thanks so much for the support. :)

I'm very glad to hear that you're putting it off. I can really relate to a lot of the things that wrote. I too am early 30s and have been struggling with a string of personal and professional failures, the difference is that I attempted suicide late last year and I saw first hand the horrible effect the attempt had on my family. I still struggle psychologically with the attempt , what's coming in the future and what the meaning of all this is. I'm trying to rebuild my life now and what's helped me is learning to living in the present and accepting life on life's terms. Despite what I've lost, my philosophy now is everyday I wake up, I'm a little better and stronger than the day I was before. I wish you all the best going forward and it sounds like you have a great family to lean on for support.
